name: program-pulse
description: Real-time Solana program monitoring on Solami: Yellowstone gRPC, Mirage, RPC. Live metrics, alerts, dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n watcher,dashboard -c green,blue "npm run dev -w watcher" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.dev:replay: concurrently -k -n watcher,dashboard -c yellow,blue "npm run dev:replay -w watcher" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w watcher && npm run build -w dashboard
